rejections.message: Place Cooking pot at Kitchen hearth, then bring Grain onto Cooking pot. Only the receiving thing needs to be placed there.

report: Stopped satisfied at the shared meal, stage 24. I expected practical combinations to help the arriving visitors; the washstand, filter chain and soap were mostly inferable. Water into a bowl and grain into a glazed bowl failed without explanation, so I used partner hints. The cooking-pot hearth error was particularly clear and useful. Making hot dishes and immediately seeing cooks serve them felt like a real payoff; I wanted to reach the table, not exhaust every recipe. The soap chain was competent but routine. Object persistence felt inconsistent: filling the same glazed bottle leaves the original empty bottle, while making seed oil removes the millstone. Combining compote and porridge also removed bread although I had not used it. I would stop comfortably here; mild curiosity about A gift for winter, not a strong urge to start another crafting chain. Logical interface only, not human or native UI evidence.
limits: Protocol-source-blind AI logical play; no human or native UI proof. CLI descriptions and corrective messages are richer than the current no-toast browser.
